meta.title: My Tale Title
meta.blurb: A one- or two-sentence teaser shown on the title screen, before roles are picked.

b1.scene: Scene text goes here — set the moment, end on the situation the prompt is about. Use \n\n for paragraph breaks. "icon" is optional — it must match a <symbol id="icon-..."> defined in campfire.html's sprite sheet near the top of <body> (currently: ticket-moon, lit-window, ledger, coat, lantern, token, receipt, constellation, platform-moon). Omit it, reuse one across several beats, or add a new <symbol> to the sprite sheet for a new picture.
b1.prompt: The question Role A answers in their own words (1-3 sentences).

fates.text: How the world answers, option 1. Written as if it already happened.
Option 2 — this one leaves a trace the story can use later.
Option 3 — another flavor of consequence, same destination or a different one.

b2.scene: role alternates automatically because you set "role": 1 here — Role B writes this time. Reference marks from b1 loosely in the prose if you like; the engine itself doesn't branch scene text on marks, only fate availability.

fates.text: A fate anyone can get, regardless of prior marks.
A fate that only appears as an option if the marks below are already held — otherwise the picker (Fate) never sees this button at all.

b3.scene: A default-path beat, reached when the gated fate above wasn't available or wasn't picked.
b3.prompt: One more prompt, if you want a longer ride before the ending.

fates.text: Leads to the special ending, if you're holding the mark for it.

b3-special.scene: A branch-specific beat only reachable via the gated fate in b2. Converge it back into the same ending pool, or give it its own.
b3-special.prompt: A prompt shaped by how this branch got here.

fates.text: Converges back to the plain ending.
Or straight to the special one.

ending-plain.scene: Closing prose. Ending beats have no role/prompt/fates — just "ending": true and the final text.

ending-special.scene: A second ending, only reachable through the gated path. Give each distinct ending its own flavor of closure.
